ae2_pattern_scaler.tooltip.multiply: Multiply every non-empty processing input and output by %s. Nothing changes if any result exceeds AE2's normal limit.
ae2_pattern_scaler.tooltip.divide: Divide every non-empty processing input and output by %s. Every result must be exact at whole-item or whole-millibucket precision and remain nonzero.
ae2_pattern_scaler.message.empty: There are no processing-pattern quantities to scale.
ae2_pattern_scaler.message.limit: Cannot %1$s %2$s: the result would exceed AE2's normal limit of %3$s.
ae2_pattern_scaler.message.inexact: Cannot %1$s %2$s: %3$s is not exactly divisible at AE2's stored precision (%4$s).
ae2_pattern_scaler.message.zero: Cannot %1$s %2$s: the result would be zero.
